name: Terminal / CRT
summary: Phosphor-green CRT terminal: green monospace on near-black green-cast glass, scanlines, blinking block cursor, prompt-driven chrome.
whenToUse: When the user asks for terminal, CRT, phosphor green, hacker, CLI, or console aesthetic.
rules: Set every surface in monospace: VT323 for display and hero type, IBM Plex Mono for body, labels, and commands — no sans or serif fallback anywhere.
Glow all bright text with text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(51,255,102,0.6) and keep the faint inset screen glow (inset 0 0 120px rgba(51,255,102,0.08)) on full-page surfaces.
Frame containers with ASCII box-drawing characters (┌─┐│└┘ for light, ╔═╗ for emphasis) and use a 1px solid #33ff66 border only where the glyphs cannot render.
Keep amber #ffb000 as the only non-green hue, reserved for warnings, attention prompts, and one highlight per view.
Set radius 0 on every panel, input, button, badge, and chip — no rounded corners in the mode.
Make state changes instant (0ms); the only motion is the blinking block cursor at steps(2, jump-none) 1s infinite and the typewriter reveal at steps(20, end).
Overlay scanlines at ~4% opacity on a 3px period using the provided gradient — texture stays subtle, never a heavy flicker.
Express chrome as a prompt rather than a button: user@host:~/dir$ followed by a blinking block cursor █ stands in for actions and section headers.

componentRecipes.card: background:#101710;border:1px solid #33ff66;border-radius:0;padding:24px;color:#33ff66;font:16px/1.6 'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;box-shadow:inset 0 0 120px rgba(51,255,102,0.08); title the card inside an ASCII frame ('┌─ CARD ─┐') and open the body with a '$ ' prompt line; a footer action row reads '[ ok ] [ edit ]' in bracketed commands.
componentRecipes.select: Render as a menu row, not a popover pill: trigger is an input-like line 'select> value' in #33ff66 with a blinking block cursor; the open list is a 1px #1e9944 frame of IBM Plex Mono rows each prefixed by '│'; the selected row inverts to background:#33ff66;color:#0a0e0a and the active item shows '>' in #ffb000; no radius, no animation beyond the cursor blink.
componentRecipes.checkbox: Bracketed glyph toggle: '[x]' or '[ ]' at 16px/1.4 IBM Plex Mono, with the checked 'x' in #33ff66 and the label in #1e9944; focus-visible wraps the pair in outline:1px solid #ffb000 offset 2px; the radio variant renders '(•)' and '()'; state is repeated as '[on]'/'[off]' in text.
componentRecipes.badge: A bracketed status tag: display:inline-block;font:14px/1 'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;padding:2px 8px;color:#0a0e0a;background:#33ff66;border-radius:0;text-transform:lowercase; role words only ([ok], [warn], [err]) with the fill swapped per role (#33ff66/#ffb000/#ff3030); never a filled pill and never color-only.
componentRecipes.avatar: A 32px square cell: background:#0a0e0a;border:1px solid #1e9944;color:#33ff66;font:20px/1 'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; shows two-letter initials or a bracketed glyph ([@]); imagery renders as a monochrome ASCII block with image-rendering:auto and a 1px green frame; radius 0.
componentRecipes.nav: A horizontal prompt rail: items are lowercase IBM Plex Mono 16px links prefixed by a two-space '│'; hover sets background:#33ff66;color:#0a0e0a; the active item keeps the inverse and prefixes '> ' in #ffb000; the vertical form is the existing menu; separators are '──' glyph runs in #1e9944, never underlines or chevrons.
componentRecipes.table: A text grid framed in ASCII: header row of UPPERCASE #33ff66 labels over a '═' rule, body rows of IBM Plex Mono 16px #33ff66 on #0a0e0a with '│' column rules and 1px #1e9944 row rules; hover inverts the row, the selected row inverts to background:#33ff66;color:#0a0e0a and prefixes '>'; numbers align in tabular mono.
componentRecipes.dialog: A modal console box: background:#0a0e0a;border:1px solid #33ff66;border-radius:0;box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(51,255,102,0.6); title in an ASCII frame ('┌─ CONFIRM ─┐'), scrim as color-mix(in srgb, var(--overlay) 60%, transparent); body opens with '$ ' and actions read '[ run ] [ exit ]'; focus traps inside and the entrance is instant (0ms).
componentRecipes.toast: A single status line pinned bottom-right: background:#0a0e0a;border:1px solid #1e9944;padding:8px 16px;font:14px/1.2 'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; prefix '[ok]'/'[warn]'/'[err]' in #33ff66/#ffb000/#ff3030 followed by the message; auto-clears by printing a new '>' prompt after 1200ms, never a fade.
componentRecipes.code: A preformatted block: background:#0a0e0a;border:1px solid #1e9944;border-radius:0;padding:16px;font:14px/1.5 'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;color:#33ff66;text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(51,255,102,0.6); preserve whitespace; comments in #1e9944, commands prefixed '$ ' in #ffb000, output in #33ff66.
componentRecipes.empty: A centred ASCII panel: a glyph illustration ('░▒▓' or a box motif) above one line '# no data' in #1e9944 and a single bracketed CTA '[ run ]'; the state is stated in words (EMPTY, NO RESULTS) and there is exactly one action.
componentRecipes.panel: background: #101710; border: 1px solid #33ff66; box-shadow: inset 0 0 120px rgba(51,255,102,0.08); border-radius: 0; padding: 24px; color: #33ff66; font: 16px/1.6 "IBM Plex Mono", "Courier New", monospace; and title it inside an ASCII frame in the same mono face, e.g. ┌─ NETWORK ─────────┐ / │ … │ / └───────────────────┘.
componentRecipes.button: font: 16px/1 "IBM Plex Mono", monospace; text-transform: lowercase; background: transparent; color: #33ff66; border: 1px solid #33ff66; border-radius: 0; padding: 8px 16px; text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(51,255,102,0.6); transition: none; label it as a bracketed command ([ run ], [ exit ]); :hover/:focus-visible { background: #33ff66; color: #0a0e0a; text-shadow: none; } with outline: 1px solid #ffb000; outline-offset: 2px.
componentRecipes.input: background: #0a0e0a; border: 1px solid #1e9944; border-radius: 0; color: #33ff66; caret-color: #33ff66; font: 16px/1.4 "IBM Plex Mono", monospace; padding: 8px 16px; text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(51,255,102,0.6); prefix the field with a literal prompt glyph (user@host:~/dir$ or >) in #1e9944; ::placeholder { color: #1e9944; } :focus { border-color: #33ff66; box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(51,255,102,0.6); outline: none; }.
componentRecipes.statusbar: position: fixed; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 10; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; background: #0a0e0a; border-top: 1px solid #1e9944; color: #1e9944; font: 14px/1 "IBM Plex Mono", monospace; padding: 8px 16px; content: user@host:~/dir on the left, connection/mode and clock on the right; escalate to #ffb000 for warnings and #ff3030 for failures.
componentRecipes.menu: list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 1px solid #1e9944; border-radius: 0; background: #0a0e0a; each item: font: 16px/1.2 "IBM Plex Mono", monospace; padding: 8px 16px; color: #33ff66; prefixed with a two-space indent and "│" so the list reads as an ASCII column; [aria-selected="true"] { background: #33ff66; color: #0a0e0a; text-shadow: none; } with the shortcut hint right-aligned in #1e9944; no underlines, no chevrons.
componentRecipes.hero: h1 { font: 400 clamp(32px, 6vw, 72px)/1.1 "VT323", "Courier New", monospace; color: #33ff66; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(51,255,102,0.6); margin: 0; } preceded by a prompt line (user@host:~/dir$ in #1e9944) and closed with a block cursor ::after { content: "\2588"; animation: blink steps(2, jump-none) 1s infinite; } reveal the line with a typewriter clip: width 0 → 100%, animation steps(20, end) 1200ms, overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap.

copywriting.voice: terse, literal, machine-voiced — an operator reading state off a console, never a marketer selling a product

do: Set everything in monospace: VT323 for headlines and hero, IBM Plex Mono for body, labels, tables, and commands.
Frame panels with ASCII box-drawing first (┌─┐│└┘) and fall back to a 1px solid #33ff66 border only when the glyphs cannot render.
Use amber #ffb000 for warnings, attention prompts, and a single highlight per view; keep everything else on the green ramp.
Report state as text — [ok], [warn], exit 0, [████░░░░] 40% — instead of color alone or icon-only indicators.
Keep corners square (radius 0) and state changes instant (0ms), so hover and focus land as a hard character-cell swap.
Open hero, form, and command areas with a prompt line and a blinking block cursor: user@host:~/dir$ █.
dont: Don't use a sans-serif, serif, or proportional font — the console illusion collapses without monospace.
Don't round corners, add blurred drop shadows, or introduce pill-shaped chips and cards.
Don't add hues beyond the green ramp and amber #ffb000 in the default phosphor-green palette (no blue, purple, or cyan).
Don't animate transitions, page loads, or hover fades; only the cursor blink and the typewriter reveal move.
Don't raise the scanline opacity or add flicker, jitter, or chromatic aberration — 4% on a 3px period, always readable.
Don't render filled rounded CTAs or icon buttons; chrome is a prompt or a bracketed command like [ run ].
accessibility: Hold body text at #33ff66 or lighter on #0a0e0a (contrast ≥ 4.5:1); #1e9944 is for secondary or large text only — measure contrast before shipping on #101710.
Never let glow carry legibility: the text-shadow is decoration, and every glyph pair must pass contrast with the glow removed.
Under prefers-reduced-motion, disable the typewriter reveal and render the block cursor solid (no blink) while keeping the prompt visible.
Pair the cursor with a non-visual cue — outline: 1px solid #ffb000 with offset 2px on :focus-visible — so keyboard users can locate the active line.
signatureElement: The blinking block cursor at a $ prompt, and the typewriter hero reveal

prose.overview: Terminal / CRT is a phosphor-green console printed on near-black, green-cast glass: monospace type, bloomed glyphs, scanlines at four percent, and a shell prompt standing in for interface chrome. It reads as an operator's view into a running machine — dense, literal, and made entirely of text. Reach for it when the surface should feel like a CLI session or a CRT terminal rather than a web page.
prose.colors: Two hues carry the whole mode: the green ramp (foreground #33ff66, muted #1e9944, surface #101710 over background #0a0e0a) builds structure and body text, while amber #ffb000 is the single permitted accent for warnings and attention. Danger red #ff3030 appears only for destructive confirmation. Backgrounds sit within a few points of black with a green cast so bright glyphs appear to bloom rather than sit flat.
prose.typography: Everything is monospace. VT323 sets display type and hero headlines at large sizes where its 8-bit stroke stays crisp; IBM Plex Mono carries body copy, labels, commands, and tables at 14–18px with 1.5–1.6 line height. Weights never drift above regular, and bright text always carries text-shadow 0 0 8px to simulate phosphor bloom.
prose.layout: Layout is a grid of framed rectangles separated by 16–32px of empty dark space, aligned to a monospace character grid so text columns line up across panels. Screens read top to bottom like terminal output: a prompt line, output blocks, then a status bar pinned to the bottom edge. Density runs high but ordered — line height is the only breathing room, and neither radius nor padding ever softens an edge.
prose.elevation: There is no z-axis: depth comes from glow and frames, never blur. Panels lie flat on the background with a 1px #33ff66 border and an inset screen glow of inset 0 0 120px rgba(51,255,102,0.08); foreground text emits a tight 0 0 8px halo. Nothing casts a drop shadow and nothing lifts on hover — the entire interface shares one plane.
prose.shapes: Square everything: radius 0 on panels, inputs, buttons, badges, and avatars. Framing is ASCII first — ┌─┐│└┘ for light frames, ╔═╗ for emphasis — with a 1px solid border only as fallback when the glyphs cannot render. Icons give way to glyphs, brackets, and block characters: [x], █, ░▒▓.
prose.components: Panels are bordered rectangles titled inside their own frame (┌─ NETWORK ─┐). Buttons read as bracketed commands — [ run ], [ exit ] — inverting to a solid #33ff66 fill with dark text on hover and carrying an amber focus outline; inputs show a $ or > prompt prefix and a green caret. The status bar is one line of dim mono type pinned to the bottom (user@host left, mode and clock right), and heroes open with a prompt line plus a blinking block cursor.
prose.dosDonts: Do keep the two-family monospace pair (VT323 display, IBM Plex Mono body), frame with ASCII before borders, reserve amber for warnings, and make every state change instant. Don't introduce a second hue family, rounded corners, animated transitions, a loud scanline flicker, or button-shaped CTAs — this mode is a prompt, not a dashboard.
